hint.label: Vocabulary List

atoms.b: Sadly, many people hold ((prejudice)) against others because of their identity.
In many societies, the ((majority)) directly or indirectly uses its power to ((oppress)) minority groups, leading to their ((marginalisation marginalization)).
For example, when a person with a ((disability)) is excluded from participating in the public sphere or treated unfairly, this is ((discrimination)).
((Racism)) also creates unequal conditions, as white people are often more ((privileged)) than people of colour.

atoms.a: sich für etw. einsetzen, Diversität, Inklusion, Minderheiten (Plural)
atoms.b: It is therefore important to ((advocate)) for ((diversity)) and to encourage ((inclusion)) by considering the circumstances of ((minorities)).
